Facsim. of ms. cadastral survey of tracts named Duddington Pasture, Duddington Manor, and New Troy.

Facsim. of ms. cadastral survey of tracts named Duddington Pasture, Duddington Manor, and New Troy. "The whole now called Cerne-Abbey Manor contains 1531 [acres]. The resurvey is distinguished by black lines." Includes notes and acreage table. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Original version: Platted by a scale of 80 equal parts in an inch by I.P. [1793?]. LC copy fold-lined and mounted on cloth backing. LC copy accompanied by photostat negative at larger scale. Negative annotated in pencil on verso: Photostat of map in Potomac Flats Case, vol. VI. DCP
